**Georgian:**
საქართველოს პრემიერ-მინისტრი ირაკლი ღარიბაშვილი ოფიციალური ვიზიტით უნგრეთის რესპუბლიკას ეწვია. მთავრობის მეთაურს ბუდაპეშტის საერთაშორისო აეროპორტში უნგრეთის ეკონომიკური განვითარების მინისტრი მარტონ ნადი დახვდა.

**English:**
The Prime Minister of Georgia, Irakli Garibashvili, has arrived in the Republic of Hungary for an official visit. The Head of Government was welcomed at Budapest International Airport by the Minister of Economic Development of Hungary, Márton Nagy.

**Irakli Kobakhidze** - Just as with the Prime Minister, the State Minister will be fully served by the resources of the Government Administration; there is nothing to ridicule here, though the opposition manages to speculate even on this – this is their true face and is of no interest (28.04.2026, 16:17)

"Just as with the Prime Minister, the Vice Prime Minister and the State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be served entirely by the resources of the Government Administration—as you can see, there is nothing to mock here, though the opposition still manages to spread speculations; this is their true face and it is not interesting," Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze told journalists.
According to him, the goal of creating the new structural unit is to further strengthen the law enforcement system.

“These changes served to further strengthen the law enforcement system. A new tier has emerged—the coordination tier. Mamuka Mdinaradze was performing this function even before, but from a specific agency. This was the de facto situation. We decided to formalize this reality, which is correct and was already established. In reality, there will be independent structures. Naturally, these are the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Security Service, and the Special State Protection Service, and [the new role] will ensure their overall coordination. The new position of State Minister is intended for this purpose, which will further strengthen the fight against crime and the effort to maintain public order. You know that during this past year, we have had fundamental changes in all directions,” Kobakhidze stated.

Furthermore, the Prime Minister responded to a question regarding parallels between the imprisoned former head of the State Security Service (SSG), Grigol Liluashvili, and Mamuka Mdinaradze, noting that “back then, processes unfolded differently; now, they are unfolding differently.”

“The situation is radically different. The context is completely different. Mamuka Mdinaradze is an exceptionally successful member of our team. Specifically, his work in the State Security Service was exceptionally successful, including in the areas of anti-corruption and terrorist crime. He implemented very significant systemic changes. This is a different background; accordingly, against this different background, future development will also be different,” Kobakhidze stated.

Parliament is considering a bill under an expedited procedure to establish the position of State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies within the Government of Georgia. According to the draft, the Government Administration will provide logistical and organizational support for the new State Minister's activities.

According to Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government decree. He also stated that the State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be located in the Government Administration building.
